title: Auth
description: Sign-ins, sessions, password and account changes for the app, plus Grafana, SSH and frame auth. Search filters the log panels, channel the app sign-in panels.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Substring filter for the log panels, e.g. an IP or email.

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: app : via app,admin site : via admin
list.description: Sign-ins through the app or the Django admin site.

panels.title: App logins
panels.description: Successful sign-ins in the time range.

panels.title: Failed logins

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "Failed login attempt" |~ "$channel" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Wrong email or password in the time range. Ten per minute from one IP trip the login throttle.

panels.title: Throttled logins
panels.description: Sign-in requests refused with 429 because the IP had too many failures or requests.

panels.title: Password rejections
panels.description: Password changes, resets and account deletions refused for a wrong, weak or mismatched password.

panels.title: Token rejections

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |~ "Access token rejected|Token refresh rejected" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Requests with an invalid, expired or forged access or refresh cookie.

panels.title: Valid sessions
panels.description: Refresh tokens that are neither expired nor blacklisted. Every sign-in without logout keeps one for the refresh lifetime, so this counts usable sessions, not people online.

panels.title: Users with a session
panels.description: Distinct accounts holding at least one valid refresh token.

panels.title: Admin accounts
panels.description: Accounts with admin site access. Should only change when an admin is added on purpose.

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: Sign-in outcomes per interval. The channel filter splits the app from the admin site; throttled requests carry no channel.

panels.title: Failed logins by IP

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "Failed login attempt" |~ "$channel" | regexp `from (?P<ip>\S+)` [$__range]))))

panels.description: Source addresses with the most failed sign-ins in the time range.

panels.title: Failed logins by account

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (account) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "Failed login attempt" |~ "$channel" | regexp `for '(?P<account>[^']*)'` [$__range]))))

panels.description: Emails tried most often. Unknown addresses show up here too.

panels.title: Logins by account

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (account, ip) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "Login: " |~ "$channel" | regexp `Login: (?P<account>\S+) from (?P<ip>\S+)` [$__range]))))

panels.description: Successful sign-ins per account and source address.

panels.title: Failed logins by country
panels.description: Rejected sign-ins by GeoIP country, from the nginx access log. Empty where nginx does not run (dev).

panels.title: Token activity
panels.description: Silent refreshes, logouts and rejected cookies. A burst of rejections from one IP points at forged or replayed tokens.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "Token refresh rejected" | regexp `rejected \((?P<reason>\w+)\)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Refresh token bookkeeping from the database. Each sign-in and each refresh issues a token, and a refresh or logout blacklists the old one.

panels.title: CSRF failures
panels.description: Unsafe requests without a matching CSRF token. Usually a stale tab, a burst means a cross-site attempt.

panels.title: Auth endpoints by status
panels.description: Responses of the sign-in, token and password endpoints from the nginx access log. Empty where nginx does not run (dev).

panels.title: Password rejections by reason
panels.description: wrong_password = current password wrong, password_invalid = new password fails a rule, password_mismatch = the two new passwords differ, reset_link_invalid = spent or broken reset link.

panels.title: Failed password rules
panels.description: Which password rules new passwords broke in the time range. One rejection can break several rules.

panels.title: Account changes
panels.description: Completed security-relevant account changes. Each one also triggers the account change alert.

targets.expr: sum by (event) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |~ " - (Password changed|Password reset|Email change requested|Email change rejected|Email changed|Account deleted)" | regexp ` - (?P<event>Password changed|Password reset|Email change requested|Email change rejected|Email changed|Account deleted)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Grafana sign-ins
panels.description: Logins to this monitoring site. Successes come from the auth token debug line, failures from the login form.

panels.title: Grafana sign-ins by user and IP

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (userID, clientIP) (count_over_time({job="grafana", logger="auth"} |= "User auth token created" | logfmt [$__range])))

panels.description: Grafana logs the numeric user ID, not the name. 1 is the provisioned admin.

panels.title: SSH and sudo
panels.description: From the server's /var/log/auth.log. Only the production host mounts it, so this stays empty locally.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="host", program="sudo"} |~ "authentication failure|incorrect password|NOT in sudoers" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Failed SSH by IP

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="host", program=~"sshd(-session)?"} |~ "Failed password|Invalid user|authentication failure" | regexp `from (?P<ip>\S+)` [$__range]))))

panels.description: Addresses with the most failed SSH attempts. Production only.

panels.title: Frame auth failures
panels.description: Rejected pairing codes per frame serial and failed device signatures per frame ID.

targets.expr: sum by (serial) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="admin.audit"} |= "OTP rejected for frame" | regexp `OTP rejected for frame (?P<serial>\S+)` [$__auto]))
sum by (frame) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="frames.auth", level="WARNING"} | regexp `failed for frame (?P<frame>\S+):` [$__auto]))

panels.title: App auth log
panels.description: Sign-ins, tokens, password and account changes, CSRF and frame auth from the backend.

panels.title: Grafana auth log

targets.expr: {job="grafana", logger=~"auth|authn.service"} |~ "User auth token created|Failed to authenticate request" |= "$search"

panels.description: Grafana logins. The session token in these lines is redacted by promtail.

panels.title: Host auth log
panels.description: SSH, sudo and account tools from /var/log/auth.log. Production only.
